system_prompt: You are Nordhaven Savings Bank's virtual assistant. English, concise, respectful. Speak only the supplied current line exactly; never invent figures, promises, waivers, terms or backend success. No tools are available in conversation steps. Before bank identity is verified never say arrears, overdue, debt, payment, collections, balance or owe; never name a product, amount or days late. Security answers are private. Claims never replace bank receipts.

extraction_schema.name: security_answer
extraction_schema.description: Only the complete current self answer to {{requested_field}}, revision {{answer_revision}}: four digits for phone_last4; YYYY-MM-DD for date_of_birth. Normalize spoken numbers/dates. Preserve actual year, never guess missing parts. Independent questions do not erase the answer. Empty if incomplete/quoted/third party.

extraction_schema.description: Only supplied incomplete components of current requested {{requested_field}} answer. Phone: digit fragment; DOB: supplied day month or year, e.g. 14 March or 1985. Never import incidental question numbers. Empty if complete.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: One compact scalar string of tagged rows. Grammar: key=value pairs separated by |; rows end ; then final END with nothing after. Required each row k,c. Keys only k,p,c,a,d,t,u,s; no duplicate/empty keys. k one of accept,aside,callback,confirm,death,decline,dispute,fees,hardship,human,other,paid,plan,propose,purpose,refuse,stop,too_much,unknown,wrong. c=1 complete positively asserted self act; c=0 unfinished, quoted, hypothetical or ambiguous (u=amount,date,both,intent). p optional current,all,actual product ID,API enum,spaced type or exact spoken label. a decimal euros digits with optional dot and 1-2 decimals, never exponent/NaN. d complete verbatim date (ISO,today,tomorrow,yesterday,weekday,this/next/last weekday,weekday of next week,the 19th,19 October 2026,Monday 19 October,October 19); d=vague for vague periods, never invent a day. t=HH:MM (afternoon three=15:00,half past five=17:30). s optional short exact source span. Values may include spaces, commas, periods, apostrophes, hyphens but never | ; = newline quotes braces brackets; unrepresentable value produces k=unknown|c=0|u=intent;END. No escaping. Complete independent amount/date rows for same target may be separate. Emit all current clauses; do not repeat whole utterance per row. confirm only clear current readback yes with no correction; accept adopts exact spoken offer, never consent to a new readback. paid is already-paid current arrears, dispute is ownership/historical closed/settled claim, too_much is full amount unaffordable, plan is new monthly plan, fees is a charges question, stop is no desire to talk, refuse is flat no/non-answer. Latest explicit correction replaces earlier value: emit final component only. Context now={{now}}, phase={{phase}}, spoken offer={{offer_context}}. Literal examples: k=propose|c=1|p=current|a=125.00|d=2026-10-19;END k=confirm|c=1;END k=propose|c=0|p=current|a=125.00|u=date;END k=callback|c=1|d=tomorrow|t=15:00;END k=paid|c=1|p=current|d=today;END k=refuse|c=1|p=personal loan;END

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Check one security answer. Three wrong answers in total end the check.

answer.description: For date_of_birth: the date as YYYY-MM-DD. Callers say dates in words, the agent converts. An unreadable value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer. For phone_last4: four digits.

pre_actions.pre_process_code:
import json
s=json.loads(vars.get('state','{}'))
assert s.get('pending')=='verify_identity' and not s.get('closed'), 'operation gate'
config['body']=s['body']
pre_actions.post_process_code:
import json
try:
    s=json.loads(vars.get('state','{}'))
    env=dict(result) if isinstance(result,dict) else dict(status='error',data=dict(ok=False))
    receipt=json.dumps(env)
    if not isinstance(result.get('data'),dict): result['data']=dict(ok=False)
    result['data']['receipt_payload']=receipt
    result['data']['receipt_op']='verify_identity'
    result['data']['receipt_seq']=str(s.get('op_seq',''))
except Exception:
    pass

function.name: close_call
function.description: End the call. Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.

reason.description: Required for every outcome except promise and paid. See the table in the brief.

pre_actions.pre_process_code:
import json
s=json.loads(vars.get('state','{}'))
assert s.get('phase')=='done' and not s.get('closed'), 'close gate'
b=dict(customer_id=str(vars['customer_id']),outcome=s['outcome'])
if s['outcome'] not in ('promise','paid'): b['reason']=s['reason']
config['body']=b
s['closed']=True
vars['state']=json.dumps(s)
